Перетащите два аудиофайла одинаковой дли:
Drop two audio files of the same length onto the Guide and Dub waveforms. In FL Studio, use Edison’s Drag/copy sample/selection control to transfer the selection or the entire sample. A Playlist clip may not provide an audio file; use sidechain capture in that case.

Insert FLOWALIGN on the Dub track. Route the Guide to the sidechain and connect the additional input in wrapper → Processing. Select “Capture: Guide + Dub”, click Capture, then press Play in the DAW. Stop ends the capture. Guide and Dub can be captured separately. Mute/Solo do not select the source.

Audition plays each signal through the Windows system output. Stop the transport first. If an exclusive ASIO device blocks playback, free the system output or listen using the host transport.

Click Align, compare Before / After and drag the output button onto the timeline. If drag and drop is unavailable, open the rendered WAV beside the output. A click does not create a track.

Imported audio has no timeline position. For Follow Host Transport, move the playhead to the start of the Dub and click the link button. Do not run the DAW as administrator; this blocks dragging from File Explorer.

Up to 8 pairs, 120 seconds per signal, and 256 MB of audio per session. Click Align again after changing settings.
Быстрый способ: обрежьте два аудиорегион:
Trim two Logic audio regions to the same length and drop them onto the Guide and Dub waveforms. Logic provides rendered files; capture is not required. Dragging does not provide a timeline position. Use the link button to set the start for Follow Logic Transport.

1. Insert FLOWALIGN on the Dub track. Select the Guide in Side Chain at the top of the Logic plug-in window.

2. Mute/Solo do not select the Guide. Keep the plug-in track enabled and select the Guide explicitly in Side Chain. Select “Capture: Guide + Dub”, set the playhead, click Capture, then press Play in Logic. Stop ends the capture.

3. To use different positions, capture the Guide and then the Dub separately. The other signal is retained. “+ Pair” adds another pair.

4. Each waveform has an Audition button for the Guide, Dub or Output through the macOS system output. Stop Logic for isolated auditioning.

5. Click Align. When the output waveform appears, audition it and compare Before / After. Changing controls retains the previous output; click Align again to render the new settings.

6. Hold “Drag to Logic” and drag it onto an empty area of the timeline. A click does not create a track. If dragging is unavailable, click “WAV in Finder” beside the output. The WAV is prepared automatically. The Dub position is shown on the left.

Automatic playback and track creation are not available: Bridge still requires testing in Logic. File import and export are also available.
